bg.purpose: Page ground; equals sunk in light so white panels separate.

card.purpose: Every raised surface and control ground.

sunk.purpose: Inset wells: secondary quote chips, segmented track, game rows, math drawer, hover rows.

sil.purpose: Inactive meter segments, dashed testing borders, scrollbars.

up.purpose: Mood accent text on its tint while CLV is flat or positive.

up-fill.purpose: Mood fill: primary buttons, Lock card, active tab underline, brand mark, risk bar.

up-soft.purpose: Ground behind mood text: Hard Rock quote chip, mood chip, soft button, on-card rows.

down.purpose: Mood text when CLV is negative; error and blocked text.

down-fill.purpose: Mood fill when CLV is negative; live dot; error toast dot.

down-soft.purpose: Ground behind coral text: failed legs, no pills, confirm strips.

warn.purpose: Warning text: notices, SAMPLE tag, injury icons.

on-mood.purpose: Text and marks on a mood fill.

bg-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Page ground; equals sunk in light so white panels separate.

card-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Every raised surface and control ground.

sunk-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Inset wells: secondary quote chips, segmented track, game rows, math drawer, hover rows.

line-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Hairline dividers and panel borders.

line-2-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Control borders, zero line.

sil-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Inactive meter segments, dashed testing borders, scrollbars.

up-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Mood accent text on its tint while CLV is flat or positive.

up-fill-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Mood fill: primary buttons, Lock card, active tab underline, brand mark, risk bar.

up-soft-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Ground behind mood text: Hard Rock quote chip, mood chip, soft button, on-card rows.

down-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Mood text when CLV is negative; error and blocked text.

down-fill-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Mood fill when CLV is negative; live dot; error toast dot.

down-soft-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Ground behind coral text: failed legs, no pills, confirm strips.

warn-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Warning text: notices, SAMPLE tag, injury icons.

warn-soft-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Ground behind warning text.

on-mood-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Text and marks on a mood fill.

series-4.purpose: Strategy chart: volume strategy (same in both themes).

series-1-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Strategy chart: current strategy.

series-2-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Strategy chart: min-3 strategy.

series-3-dark.purpose: Dark-theme value. Strategy chart: model-15 strategy.

moodAliases.switch: data-mood on :root; 'down' when live average CLV is negative with at least one graded bet, otherwise 'up'.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the card's risk figure.

title.purpose: Player names on quote cards and section heads.

quote.purpose: Hard Rock's price in the quote chip; Worth and Bet at 17px.

label.purpose: Chip labels, meta; uppercase only for table column headers and status badges.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hovered quote card, tooltip, sign-in, toast, phone lock bar.

shadows.name: mood-halo
shadows.purpose: Hover on primary button and Lock card (3px on soft button).

shadows.name: segment-thumb
shadows.purpose: Pressed option in a segmented control.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: House ease for every state change.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button background, halo and scale(0.97) press.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Locked ticket legs clip in; risk bar width.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Compacts rule pills on the board.

breakpoints.name: dock-folds
breakpoints.purpose: Dock folds under main; two-column quote grid; only the mood chip stays.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Bottom tab bar, lock bar, one column, restacked board rows.

components.css: :host{--bg:#f2f4f5;--card:#fff;--sunk:#f2f4f5;--ink:#0f1417;--ink-2:#48535a;--mute:#66717a;--line:#e4e8ea;--line-2:#d2d8db;--sil:#b9c1c5;--mood:#077a45;--mood-ink:#06733f;--mood-soft:#e2f5eb;--on-mood:#fff;--good:#06733f;--good-soft:#e2f5eb;--bad:#b8311c;--bad-soft:#fce9e5;--warn:#855600;--warn-soft:#fbf0d6;--focus:#2563eb;--nba:#f28c28;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(15 20 23 / 0.05), 0 6px 20px rgb(15 20 23 / 0.06);--shadow-up:0 2px 6px rgb(15 20 23 / 0.08), 0 14px 32px rgb(15 20 23 / 0.1);--r:14px;--r-sm:10px;--font:"Archivo Variable","Archivo",system-ui,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);font-family:var(--font);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink);} .ds-score{display:inline-grid;gap:3px;min-width:132px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);} .ds-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font:800 15px var(--font);font-stretch:112%;} .ds-row span{font-weight:700;} .ds-score small{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:700 11px var(--font);color:var(--mute);} .ds-live{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#d43c25;animation:ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;} @keyframes ds-pulse{50%{opacity:.35;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-live{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
The desk reads like a clean trading app for player props. The player is the ticker, Hard Rock's price is the quote you can take, the fair price is what it is worth, and value is the day's change. Surfaces are rounded raised panels on a quiet ground; controls are pills; one typeface, Archivo, does all the work, opening up to a wider stretch for the names and figures that matter. The look was pinned by the user as a clean modern sportsbook at Robinhood's level of polish, and it replaces the ink-ruled "Games System" entirely.

The single expressive device is the mood accent. Every primary action, the active tab, the brand mark, the card's risk bar and the headline quote chip share one accent that is green while the desk is beating the closing line (or has no record yet) and coral when it is not. The rest of the interface stays neutral so that the accent carries meaning, not decoration.

Density is a calm desk, not an odds screen: two columns of quote cards beside a docked card panel on laptops, one column with a lock bar and a bottom tab bar on phones. Both themes are designed; the app follows the system setting until the user picks one, and game nights are expected to run dark.
keyCharacteristics: One mood accent (green up, coral down) drives every primary action and headline figure.
Archivo variable only; names and figures at width 112, weight 800, tabular numerals everywhere.
Rounded raised panels (14px) and pill controls; soft shadow in light, none in dark.
League colour appears only as a small dot.
Calm motion: short, eased state changes; nothing celebratory.

rules.name: The Mood Rule
rules.body: There is one accent, and it means something: green while the desk beats the close, coral when it does not. Every primary action, the active tab and the headline quote take it; nothing else gets a second accent.

rules.name: The Dot Rule
rules.body: Sport colour enters only as a small dot fed by data. The shell, palette and type stay sport-agnostic.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Status and accent text sit on their own soft tint (up-soft, down-soft, warn-soft) rather than on a saturated fill; saturated fills are reserved for the primary action.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Names and figures at width 112, everything else at 100. A wide setting on body copy, or a second family, breaks the ticker.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in tabular figures so prices, stakes and scores align in columns and do not jitter when they update.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Intent Rule
rules.body: Panels rest on the soft shadow; only something the user is pointing at or must act on now gets the lift. Hovered quote cards rise 2px.

rules.name: The Dark-Is-Flat Rule
rules.body: In dark, resting panels carry no shadow; separation comes from the ground, card and sunk values.

dos: **Do** route every primary action, active state and headline figure through the mood accent, and let `data-mood` decide green or coral.
**Do** set player names and figures in Archivo at width 112, weight 800, with tabular numerals.
**Do** put accent and status text on its own soft tint (up-soft, down-soft, warn-soft).
**Do** keep panels at 14px radius with a 1px line border and the Rest shadow in light, no resting shadow in dark.
**Do** make every interactive control a full pill at least 36px tall (44-48px for phone targets).
**Do** keep 11px as the type floor and the 2.5px focus-blue outline on everything focusable.
**Do** show league identity only as a 7-8px dot.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second accent colour or a second typeface.
**Don't** colour surfaces, borders or type by league.
**Don't** add resting shadows in dark, or hard offset shadows anywhere.
**Don't** go back to the ink-ruled spreadsheet: no heavy black rules, no square-cornered panels.
**Don't** add celebration or pressure: no confetti, streak flames, countdowns or bouncing motion; state changes stay at 120-320ms on the house ease and stop under reduced motion.
